description: What the Portuguese municipal master plan (PDM, Plano Diretor Municipal) allows at a point (WGS84 latitude, longitude), at a street address or on a plot polygon: municipality, land-use category from the official land-use map, whether it is buildable, floor-area index, maximum floors, regulation articles, RAN and REN reserves, national easements and restrictions it touches (Natura 2000 SAC, protected areas, road, rail, power line, aviation and military easements, reservoirs, groundwater abstraction protection), applicable provisional planning norms, municipal notices requiring confirmation, their official sources, and a link to the full analysis on pdm.xyzbim.eu. Mainland Portugal and the Azores. Field values are in Portuguese. Each result carries its source attribution. With a plan key in the connector URL (?chave=), the full regulation fields (height, coverage, minimum plot area, uses, conditions) are returned and the plan quota is used. (PT: o que o PDM permite num ponto ou num terreno.)

lat.description: WGS84 latitude (e.g. 40.15); with lon, a 20 m x 20 m plot centred on the point

morada.description: street address or place name in Portugal instead of lat/lon, with locality and municipality (e.g. "Rua da Liberdade 12, Buarcos, Figueira da Foz"); it is geocoded to an approximate point, returned in `morada` for the user to confirm

poligono.description: optional plot polygon instead of lat/lon: 3 to 500 [longitude, latitude] vertices (WGS84)

name: pdm_terreno
title: PDM rules at a point
